questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code propagates cancellation to the outbound driver offers? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
Several drivers accept at nearly the same time. What does Assign return?
choices: An error, since more than one driver accepted
The driver whose offer completed last, because later sends overwrite the channel value
Exactly one driver: the first to place itself on the buffered channel; later accepts fall into the default case
All of them, as the channel collects every acceptance

questions.prompt: Why does the goroutine check ctx.Err() before calling Offer?
choices: To avoid starting new offers once a winner exists or the window has closed, since g.SetLimit may delay goroutines until earlier ones finish
Because Offer panics when called with a cancelled context
To release the semaphore slot held by the errgroup
Because errors.Is cannot detect cancellation inside Offer

questions.prompt: The rider closes the app and their request context is cancelled while offers are pending and no driver has accepted yet. How does the handler respond?
choices: It writes nothing and returns, since the client is gone
It waits for the offerWindow to elapse before responding
